quickAnswer: Foreign passport holders can book through Railway 12306 English after the requested verification. Check the train and stations, and carry the identity document used for the ticket. Ask station staff if a passport reader does not work.

sections.title: How to Register on 12306 English
sections.summary: Enter the requested passport and email details, then complete the verification shown by the official service.
items: Open the official Railway 12306 English website, or choose English in the official app when that option is available.
Use the passport accepted by the service. Enter the name, passport number, expiry date and other requested details accurately; use an email address you can access.
Complete the verification requested for the account and passenger. Check the resulting status and seek official support if the details cannot be verified before booking.

The English website lists foreign passports for registration. Read its passport-name instructions when entering your name, and follow the status shown for the passenger instead of assuming registration guarantees a ticket.

sections.title: Boarding: No Paper Ticket
sections.summary: Carry the identity document used for your e-ticket and use station assistance if the gate cannot read it.
items: For an e-ticket, carry the valid identity document used for purchase and keep the trip details.
An itinerary sheet is not a boarding ticket. Ask station staff if the passport reader does not work.
Allow time to reach the station, complete security and identity checks, and find your platform.

faqs.question: Can foreigners book China trains on 12306?
faqs.answer: Yes. The English service accepts valid foreign passports under its rules. Complete the requested passenger verification and check seat availability.

faqs.question: Do I need a Chinese ID card?
faqs.answer: The English registration service accepts foreign passports. Use your accepted passport details and carry the same valid document when travelling.

faqs.question: Do I need to collect a paper ticket?
faqs.answer: With an e-ticket, carry the identity document used for purchase. Ask staff if the reader fails. An itinerary sheet is not a ticket.

faqs.question: When should I book popular routes?
faqs.answer: Check the official sale opening and availability for your date and stations. Prepare verification ahead of time; a booking request does not guarantee a confirmed seat.
